This data feeds into IBM SPSS Modeler as a analytical model for building the enhanced individual customer mobility, usage, and location profiles. This data is subsequently used for IBM SPSS Modeler + R reports for visualization and omni channel integration and to define predictive actions over Customer Insight's clusters
